headline: Europe Joins US-Led "Pax Silica" Initiative, Aligning on Global AI Supply Chain Security
summary: This signals a major geopolitical alignment, with European nations formally joining a US-led initiative to secure the entire AI supply chain, encompassing chips, critical minerals, energy, and compute. It represents a significant step towards a bloc-based approach to tech sovereignty, further fragmenting global AI infrastructure and semiconductor supply chains as major economies coalesce to control strategic resources.
